recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-15676 unless a later work-group decision intentionally changes document Bundle invariant semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-15676 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 change request asking that the mandatory document date and the rule that a document Bundle begins with a Composition be enforced by Bundle invariants.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit f0690edbf6e6d7f4b833f9c9c46ffad54696a1be, matching Jira's svn revision 14408 comment. That commit added bdl-10 for document date and bdl-11 for document first resource to the historical Bundle spreadsheet source.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml contains bdl-10 and bdl-11. The document date invariant now checks Bundle.timestamp rather than Bundle.meta.lastUpdated because later Published issue FHIR-22709 corrected bdl-10. The documents page also identifies Bundle.timestamp as the mandatory document date. FHIR-32775 later noted that the base Bundle rules already enforce the first-resource Composition requirement, and FHIR-54516 is a separate pending clarification about Composition.meta.lastUpdated that does not alter this Bundle invariant.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source files were changed because the current authoritative Bundle StructureDefinition already has type = 'document' implies timestamp.hasValue() and type = 'document' implies entry.first().resource.is(Composition).
